name: What is the process for custom stair rail design and installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for custom stair rail design and installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our custom stair rail process begins with a detailed consultation to understand your vision and measure your space. We then develop a design plan, incorporating your chosen materials and style while ensuring compliance with local building codes. Once approved, the materials are sourced, and the railing is fabricated off-site if necessary, before our team professionally installs it. This comprehensive process ensures a unique and perfectly fitted railing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design planning, material sourcing, fabrication, and professional installation for a custom fit.
